summary_evidence_spans: This study investigated the AI tools used by kindergarten teachers, their educational purposes, implementation challenges, and technology acceptance factors influencing AI integration in Malang, Indonesia.
The design used was an exploratory sequential mixed-methods approach.
Ten Guru Penggerak and five kindergarten administrators participated in interviews, observations, and document analysis to gather qualitative data.

original_excerpt: 115年創作營集結全臺國小、國中及高級中等學校共30位教師，任教領域橫跨音樂、藝術生活、視覺藝術、表演藝術及多媒體音樂，透過2日、共計11小時的實戰課程，從A&R創作企劃、AI工具應用到歌曲創作，帶領教師實際走過流行音樂製作歷程，將第一線產業新知與創作思維帶回校園，培養學生的音樂審美、表達與創作能力。 … 首日從AI工具應用切入，導入A&R實務，引導教師分析業界收歌需求、整合不同曲風並撰寫創作計畫，再進行分組創作；第2天則聚焦曲風與Beat分析，進一步尋找或生成Beat伴奏，並由專業創作者加入各組協作完成歌曲。 … 除了完成作品，本屆課程也聚焦AI時代下創作者不可取代的核心能力，引導教師釐清作品內容、目標聽眾及風格情緒，透過不同曲風的聆聽與分析，從「我覺得好聽」進一步理解「我為什麼喜歡」，建立自身的音樂判斷與審美。

summary_evidence_spans: This article develops embodied education as an orientation for examining how learners judge AI-supported activity within bodily, temporal and institutional conditions.
Its central concept is embodied judgement: the context-sensitive appraisal of technological possibilities, bodily and affective experience, educational purposes and feasible courses of action.

The framework distinguishes four interdependent components with different analytical roles: bodily awareness supplies experiential cues; situated judgement interprets those cues alongside evidence and task demands; movement-based learning provides one pedagogical means of developing and revising understanding; and ethical agency concerns justified action and responsibility towards others.
It develops classroom activities, provisional indicators and an illustrative policy comparison of Norway, Finland and Singapore.
The contribution is a relational account of the AI–health literacy interface, not a validated scale or intervention.
The principal application is secondary education, where increasingly independent technology use coexists with substantial institutional control over time and assessment.
